newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 11,300 MT were mainly the result of major increases for Canada (17,700 MT) and Venezuela (10,700 MT) being more than offset by reductions for unknown destinations (50,000 MT, corrections to 1997/98). Sales activity for the 1997/98 marketing year of 151,000 MT were for unknown destinations (136,000 MT) and Colombia (15,000 MT).
Exports of 71,700 MT were 71 percent above the previous week, but 22 percent below the 4-week average. Venezuela (19,500 MT), Guatemala (14,600 MT), and Japan (13,900 MT) were the major recipients.
